_readme: Datasheet values the KiCad importer cannot read from the board files. volt2motion import-kicad uses parts.json in the current folder, or pass --parts. The guide at https://github.com/paperview/volt2motion/blob/main/docs/parts-table.md says where each value is on a datasheet. Keys must match the part's MPN field (or its Value if there is no MPN). The EXAMPLE parts are made-up values for the sample board, not real parts. Add your real MOSFETs from their datasheets, using the hot (100 C) column where a datasheet gives one for gate charge.
